visualCharacteristics.purpose: columns of tick-icon list items (covered events, useful links)

contentPattern.structure: each cell is a column: optional image, optional heading/intro, and a bulleted list; a cell without a list is a full-width note/footnote. List items that start with an icon (e.g. :cross:) keep that icon instead of the default tick

usage.when: covered/not-covered checklists and link lists flowing in columns

reuseGuidance: light boxes the lists in a panel; image puts a picture over each list; image-alt gives two wide columns with headings.
